svg.title: Independently transformed stencils with inverse turns therefore give the same free two-point form for all s, t, with fixed relative endpoints. The finite covariance is c2 S P s,t ordinarys,t(h; x, y; As, Bt). Expanding both wave factors in PT18 gives the same finite double average of infinite-lattice shell forms; integrability justifies interchange with the integral. The separated chart limit gives the same free pairing for each summand. At equal endpoints the return chart limit makes each ordinary form minus its shell form tend to zero.
